## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Relevant platform or integration checks
- [ ] Documentation/release notes updated if needed

## Safety review

- [ ] No secrets or private data are included.
- [ ] No silent network access, destructive action, or unconfirmed project mutation was added.
- [ ] AI/remote-data behavior and consent boundaries were reviewed.
- [ ] Generated files and unrelated changes were excluded.

## Notes for reviewers

List known limitations, skipped host-specific tests, migration concerns, or follow-up work.
